entities.name: PMID:27490714
observations: In 21 male combat veterans (10 PTSD, 11 controls), quadriceps intramuscular capsaicin was used to assess pain and temporal summation while CSF cytokines were sampled for 110 minutes.

TNF-α, IL-6, and IL-8 increased in both groups; IL-1β increased significantly only in PTSD. IL-10 increased within 10 minutes in controls but its increase was delayed in PTSD, not consistently elevated until 70 minutes.
Retrieved abstract-level evidence does not state or quantify between-group differences in pain ratings or temporal summation.
